title: 2권 12유닛 장면 · 1
prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble, Beads). Scene: Grand finale on the Word Pond at golden sunset: a round stage of big lily pads floats in the middle of the pond with the finished bridge of stepping stones leading to it, every stone glowing softly. Pip stands at the front of the stage singing with its beak wide open and golden notes streaming up; Grumble sits beside it beating the red pot like a drum with two spoons, grinning, his lantern hanging above the stage like a bright star; Beads stands on a tall reed conducting with a string of rainbow beads; Bun and Hedgie dance on either side. All the animal friends (the cat, the pig, the dog, the fox, the ox, the pup, the ten hens) clap from the stones and the banks. Paper lanterns and petals everywhere. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers. Beads is a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads.
